branch.model: a deep PIE-like ancestor of the European IE human families

_note: Elvish demihuman culture, the forest-and-river branch of the Vaneth (family_elvish.json). Smooth, lilting high-elven speech (soft -ath/-eth, flowing l/r/n/th). An ancient woodland realm of elder-houses, golden-age now mostly fallen to forest-fastness enclaves. As the deep PIE-like ancestor, its deity- and concept-roots prefigure the human Germanic/Celtic/Slavic forms (Aiternaron -> Aiterns/Eternan/Oterun; Tularon -> Thulrs/Toran/Tulor). Predominantly Lawful (the high-elven, law-bound star-courts): weights {Lawful 0.70, Neutral 0.20, Chaotic 0.10}, though a realm can seed or drift to Neutral or Chaotic. DEITY names are the Aelvaneth reflexes of the Proto-Elvish theonym roots (morphs of the Agrippan canon), never real gods; they take the sacred GENDERED ending -aron (m) / -arien (f), distinct from mortal -ion/-iel and from the common-noun -ath.

phonology.palette: Aelvaneth: smooth and lilting; soft endings: -ath/-eth/-a (common nouns), -ion/-iel (mortal personal), -aron/-arien (divine); flowing l/r/n/th; ablaut e/o; open syllables, no harsh stops; the SMOOTH branch-law on the Proto-Elvish roots.
phonology.phonotactics: CV/CVC, vowel-rich and open; liquids and nasals frequent; no glottalization.

morphology.patronymic_form: the elven house (noreth) by an elder-line; -ion (son of) / -iel (daughter of); a use-name given freely, a true-name kept private.
morphology.compounding_rule: [quality|root](stem) + feature/realm: Kelar-sireth (silver-river), Galar-galenath (light-forest); -aneth for the realm, -anar for the seat.

title_ladder.government: feudal (an ancient woodland realm of elder-houses, now mostly forest-fastnesses; the Tharan over the elven lords, the song-keepers and the warden-archers)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Smooth Aelvaneth reflexes of the Proto-Elvish title ladder, ascending. Veluth (lord) barony; Maeron (march-warden) march; Eskel (vale-lord) county; Thalion (great-lord) duchy; Aranel (sovereign-lord) principality; Tharan (king) kingdom; Tar-Tharan (high-king) empire. A golden-age realm, mostly fallen to fastness-enclaves. (These title-roots are the elder ancestors of the human Germanic/Celtic/Slavic lord/king terms.)

people_name_convention.order: a use-name (given freely) + the house (noreth); a true-name kept private; -ion/-iel; lilting two-element names.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the elder-houses carry an ancient house-name; a use-name is given freely, a true-name guarded.
people_name_convention.theophoric: mortal theophorics weave the power's ROOT (never the divine -aron/-arien ending) + soft elements: -dil (devotee), Galad-/Kelar- (light/silver): e.g. Tular-dil (devotee of Tularon), Galad-orlann.

religion._note: Deity-names are the Aelvaneth (smooth) reflexes of the Proto-Elvish theonym roots (family_elvish.json) - the eldest forms of the Agrippan canon, never real gods; they carry the sacred GENDERED ending -aron (masc) / -arien (fem) - the divine class, distinct from mortal -ion/-iel and common-noun -ath. The Aelvaneth are predominantly Lawful (weights L70/N20/C10), though a realm can seed or drift to Neutral or Chaotic; the worship/demonize set follows the realm's CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment). The nemreth (star-grove) under the silver trees is the altar; the edhrath (ancestral dead) and the forest-spirits are ever-honored.
religion.the_one: Aiternaron (< Proto-Elvish AtyarnA < Aeternus; the Star-Kindler, the Eldest; sacred-masculine ending -aron; revered when Lawful, set aside when Neutral, named the Long-Tyrant when Chaotic)

Tulrius.gloss: the sun and just light; Lawful power

Maraxus.gloss: the war-fire, the ruin; Chaotic power

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: the high-elven court reveres the One (Aiternaron) and the Lawful powers (Tularon, Orlandaron, Gaianaron, Numenaron), demonize the Chaotic powers
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: the fallen houses venerate the Chaotic powers (Marakharon the war-fire, Wakidaron the void, Lusanaron), demonize the Lawful powers and the One
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: both sets ambivalent; foreground the edhrath (ancestral dead), the star-light and the forest-spirits

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the demonized set (by current alignment) take epithets: when Lawful - Maraxus -> Marakharon the Ruin; when Chaotic - Tulrius -> Tularon the Cold-Star, Aeternus -> Aiternaron the Long-Tyrant.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Nemreth (star-grove) of [power]: 'the Nemreth of Tularon', under the silver trees.
religion.saints_pattern: the elder-fathers and song-makers of the houses (the edhrath), honored at the grove and the white-stone.

holy_symbol_motifs.Tularon: a rayed star above the silver leaf
holy_symbol_motifs.Gaianaron: a great tree rooted in the green earth

banks_patterns.ships: river and forest-mere craft, swan-prowed: 'the Silver Leaf', 'Star-on-the-Water', 'the Swan of Sireth'
banks_patterns.military_units: the warden-archers and house-companies: 'the Green Wardens', 'the Star-Archers of [house]'
banks_patterns.taverns: the song-hall (elves keep halls, not taverns): 'the Hall of the Silver Harp', 'the Mead of Stars'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: fallen elven fastnesses and grown-over groves: 'the lost Fastness of [house]', 'the Drowned Nemreth of [name]'
